Start with `tw_status(result)`, then `tw_quality_report(result)`. `tw_trial()` returns a
failed result for diagnosis by default. `tw_quality_rows(result)` automatically
selects a single failed rule; if several fail, it lists the available choices.
`tw_run()` and `tw_publish()` stop on failure by default. For interactive inspection,
pass `stop_on_failure = FALSE`; retain their strict defaults in scheduled jobs.

## A delivery is blocked

| Symptom | Next action |
|---|---|
| A quality rule fails | Inspect `tw_quality_report(result)`, then `tw_quality_rows(result)`; select a named rule if several fail |
| A contract rejects a table | Check column names, types, missing values, duplicate keys and unexpected columns |
| `tw_collect()` reports no successful output | Inspect the failed result instead; correct the source and rerun the same definition |
| A lookup rejects rows | Check for unmatched input keys and duplicate or missing lookup keys |
| A rule errors or has no evaluable rows | Fix the rule or input; an unexecuted check is not a pass |

Follow [Check a delivery](check-delivery.html) for a complete failure and recovery.
Checks do not silently repair or remove data.

## Storage does not behave as expected

| Symptom | Next action |
|---|---|
| Optional DuckDB is missing | Install `duckdb` >= 1.5.5 in the R library used by this session |
| A new folder is DuckDB, but you wanted DuckLake | Create a new folder with `backend = "ducklake"`; reopening cannot switch an existing backend |
| DuckLake cannot load its extension | Check extension availability and network access in your environment; see [DuckLake setup](create-ducklake.html) |
| A folder reports conflicting settings | Reopen with only its path; do not overwrite the saved backend or layer choices |
| An older custom-layer folder needs `layers` | Supply its original layers once in their intended order on a writable open |
| Unchanged rows disappeared after a correction | The input replaced the whole table or supplied partition; provide a complete delivery, not only changed rows |
| A new publication was rejected | The earlier accepted release remains available; fix the input before retrying |

Do not delete a real lake to clear an error. Writer coordination, interrupted
writes and deliberate recovery belong in the
[operations guide](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/blob/main/docs/OPERATIONS.md).

## A report cannot be issued or differs from current data

Reports need published lake inputs and explicitly approved, versioned metrics.
A trial result is useful for exploration but cannot be issued as a report.
Use [Save a report](save-report.html) to follow the supported sequence.

An older report remaining unchanged after a correction is expected. Read its
saved values with `tw_report_read()`. To issue changed content, use a new report ID.
Declaring `dimensions = "company"` allows grouping; it does not group automatically.
Request company totals with `tw_measure(..., by = "company")`.
For a stock metric, select one reporting date with `at`; do not sum stocks
across dates. [Monthly reporting](getting-started.html) demonstrates this distinction.

## An integration fails

Use [dbt diagnostics](dbt-workflows.html#diagnose-a-failed-invocation) for CLI
failures and [integration boundaries](optional-integrations.html) for connection
ownership and supported lazy operations. A failed publication does not undo
earlier writes made by an external dbt project.

If you need help, [open an issue](https://github.com/JanWein/tidyweave/issues)
with a small synthetic example, the expected and actual result, R and package
versions, and your backend. Exclude credentials and production rows.
